name: Rivertown Campground (Vevay)
evidence: Indiana 2022-25 leaf-off ortho at 38.7457,-85.0614: S01-S18 pads sit riverward of the gravel row road, ~25 m to the Ohio through a thin bare bank fringe, no road between; Campspot per-site map draws them last before the river; operator photos of S7/S9 show river right behind the pad. All bookable nightly, 50 ft; older Esri frames predate the row.

name: Wabash & Erie Canal Park
evidence: Indiana leaf-off ortho at 40.5906,-86.6816 + operator site map: sites D/E/G on open lawn 30-60 m from the ~20 m Wabash & Erie Canal across the gravel towpath/driveway, so no on-water value. A canal has no vocabulary word and bank height is unknown (operator's Site G photo does not confirm a sightline), so no view is earned either.

name: Westwood Park
evidence: Indiana leaf-off ortho at 39.8986,-85.4312 and 39.8998,-85.4308 + operator Point Campground site map: outer-row and south-tip pads 28-45 m from the lake through a continuous wooded band, none within 25 m and no open apron; water visible through the band from the open loop, so view holds.

name: Deam Lake State Recreation Area
evidence: Indiana leaf-off ortho at 38.4712,-85.8620 + DNR map: peninsula campground pads 40-70 m from both lake arms through continuous woods, including the clearings at the F13-F16 lead; the shore-tip buildings are cabins, which do not count. Real wooded buffer, no open sightline.

name: Grandpa's Farm Campground
evidence: Indiana leaf-off ortho at 39.8886,-84.8416 and 39.8893,-84.8398: Middle Fork Whitewater, ~16-20 m wide (creekside by size), runs along the park's north edge; river-row pads ~15-25 m from it through a thin bank fringe, no road between. Campspot per-site map draws sites 48-58 and 90-95 along it, bookable nightly. Stored 'no river' was wrong; Campspot's 'Waterfront' type tag not relied on.

name: Ferdinand State Forest Campground
evidence: Indiana leaf-off ortho at 38.2588,-86.7726 + Esri frame: forest clearing with pads legible, no water within the 450 m frame; Ferdinand Lake and its boat launch ~300-400 m SW, ponds ~300-400 m E and N, all through forest.

name: Lynnville Park Campground
evidence: Indiana leaf-off ortho at 38.1949,-87.3262 + town per-site map: one end pad of the full-hookup block, inferred to be site 115 by overlaying the map, ~22 m from the lake arm across lawn and a tree fringe with a pine at the nearest point; rest of the block is farther, row 101-112 has the park road between it and the water, 121-125 are long-term. Lakefront not earned on one inferred pad; lakeview stands.

name: Paynetown Campground
evidence: Indiana leaf-off ortho at 39.07636,-86.43963 and 39.0773,-86.44171 + DNR per-site map: water-side spurs at sites ~170-172 and 153-154 end ~6-15 m from the high-water bank and ~20-25 m from the drawn-down waterline, no road between (low eroded bank). Other outer rows sit 40-65 m back through woods.
